pending_commit.commit_message: lakitu: run containerd as an individual systemd service Create a separate systemd service file for containerd and make it run as an individual service. This prevents docker from supervising containerd. BUG=b:122733111 TEST=tryjob RELEASE_NOTE=Created a separate service file to run containerd as an individual systemd service. CQ-DEPEND=CL:*791031 Change-Id: I1788744b6bddfa1a49e6a89618692339be2f0158 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1407571 Commit-Ready: Ke Wu <mikewu@google.com> Tested-by: Ke Wu <mikewu@google.com> Reviewed-by: Daniel Wang <wonderfly@google.com>

smbprovider: Add PremounOptionsProto - PremountOptionsProto is used to mount preconfigured shares. Preconfigured shares will be mounted regardless if the share requires credentials or not. - Adds Dbus bindings to support PremountOptionsProto. BUG=chromium:878502 TEST=emerges, unittests Change-Id: I756ff143dc880a8fa7dea2476feea742387e73be Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1407465 Commit-Ready: jimmy gong <jimmyxgong@chromium.org> Tested-by: jimmy gong <jimmyxgong@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Zentaro Kavanagh <zentaro@chromium.org>
